messages:
maya: Noticed a flurry of tiny GPU pods Pending in ap-southeast1; scheduler logs show repeated "prebind: reservation found but no slot after final check". Anyone seeing this elsewhere?
raj: I hit a cluster of pending pods in eu-west1 earlier today, thought it was warmpool churn.
nana: (ana) can you paste the scheduler trace?
maya: here's the snippet repeating on every attempt:
```scheduler: prebind failed for pod gpu-slim-01; err=reservation_ok_but_slot_missing; node=warmpool-012; reservation=rs-8912```
nana: that pattern smells like the prebind fast-path race we enabled last week.
tony: quick `kubectl` overview:```$ kubectl get pods -n models -o wide | grep Pending
gpu-slim-01    0/1 Pending 0 3m
gpu-slim-02    0/1 Pending 0 7m
training-batch-7 0/1 Pending 0 12m```
infra-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up nodepool ap-se1-warmpool by +1 at 2025-07-12T09:02:10Z (pending pods threshold).
raj: Autoscaler provisioned nodes but scheduler still fails to bind -> points to mismatch between reservation metadata and node labels/taints at bind time.
nana: Did we push any label/taint renames during the node image rollout?
maya: Yes  nodes were relabeled as part of the node image update: `gpu.family: small-2` -> `gpu.family: small-2b`. Reservations were created before relabel. prebind sees reservation but final predicate disallows binding due to label mismatch.
raj: So reservations are sticky to older label values. That explains similar eu-west incidents during their upgrade.
tony: Short-term options: 1) revert the late-prebind optimization (slow), 2) patch scheduler to accept configured alias mappings for a grace window, 3) temporarily relax the final strict label-check for reservations.
nana: Tradeoffs: relaxing check risks placing pods on slightly different GPU class (perf delta), but keeps P95 scheduling latency low.
maya: I'm leaning toward a regional canary: disable the strict final-check in ap-southeast1 scheduler config for 10 minutes and watch Pod Pending->Running transition rate + eviction noise. I'll also instrument a metric `scheduler.prebind_alias_bypass` when we allow alias matches.
raj: I'll stand by to revert and monitor eviction counts. I'll also open a PR to add explicit label alias mappings to scheduler config so upgrades are handled cleanly.
maya: Applying canary patch now: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"prebindStrict":"false","aliasGraceSec":"600"}}'`
infra-bot: Deploy: scheduler canary ap-se1 revision v2025.7.12-canary-1 by maya at 2025-07-12T09:04:50Z
maya: logs show alias bypass events:```I0712 09:05:02 scheduler.go: prebind_alias_bypass: pod=gpu-slim-01 reservation=rs-8912 allowed alias match (gpu.family small-2 -> small-2b)```
maya: after the change, 4/8 Pending pods moved to Running within ~30s.
nana: Keep canary for 20m; if >8% of scheduled pods land on a different `gpu.family` than requested, revert immediately. Add a release-note blurb about this behaviour for nodepool upgrades.
raj: I'll draft the PR for permanent alias support and a migration job to reconcile reservations post-upgrade.
tony: Also add an alert if `scheduler.prebind_alias_bypass` spikes unexpectedly.
maya: Notifying oncall+infra. Will roll out global fix after PR lands. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
